=================== Release 00455 ================================
This Release Notes file covers these blobs:
 * tz_ac_config.elf
 * hyp_ac_config.elf

Version : 00455

Release Date : Dec 22, 2025

Supported Silicon : x1p42100

Changes since last version :
 * AC policy for TFA and TZ memory regions.
 * SW aperture changes w.r.t QPSI access.
 * AC policy changes to enable SMMU configuration.
